correctness.rationale: The source relation gives \(\omega^{16}=-1\) and \(\omega^{32}=1\), hence order \(32\), which excludes primitivity in a group of order \(2400\). The quartic \(X^4-X^2-1\) is checked to have no linear or quadratic factor over \(\mathbb F_7\), so its root still supplies the printed basis. Exact arithmetic gives \(\alpha^2=-1\), preserving the generator divisor of \(x^4-1\). The projective rank classification is proved by a relation-incidence count and independently replayed by exhaustive enumeration of all \(2402\) projective message lines. The resulting counts \(1,49,2352\) multiply by \(2400\) nonzero scalars to the claimed rank-weight enumerator.
